model_status: 單一中央軌梁、單車往復式概念三維CAD；非原廠U4-430 CAD、非核定接口或施工設計
coordinate_system: 局部座標；X沿正立面、Y向建築後方、Z向上；地坪Z=0，非絕對高程

assumptions.all_numeric_parameters: 本檔所有建築尺寸均為建立可修改概念模型所採暫設值；不是從圖面量測獲得，也未經使用者核定。
assumptions.levels: 保留V0.1樓層鏈；4F月台區依假設車軌高差局部下凹，非核定月台高程。
assumptions.geometry: 僅鎖定三張參考圖共通的造型及空間關係，不宣稱毫米級還原。
assumptions.area: 未將21,510平方公尺土地或1,720.35坪商店街轉作單棟總樓地板面積；本模型不作法定面積計算依據。
assumptions.rail: 依使用者本次要求，建立一條行車線及一根中央軌梁的概念配置。中央單梁截面、車頂開槽及走行接口未獲原廠尺寸證實，不宣稱是U4-430原廠構造。
assumptions.site: 展示基座不代表地籍界線、道路線形或核定基地配置。
assumptions.cutaway: 選擇性剖透視：隱藏前側外皮與部分前屋頂；不是單一剖切平面。

rail_interface.status: All dimensions inherited or assumed; only one-path / one-centered-member configuration is user-required. No georeferenced control adopted.
rail_interface.route_direction: Local +X only; not verified P2 azimuth; extension is an inherited geometric proposal, not the full route.
rail_interface.operating_topology: SINGLE_LINE_REVERSIBLE_SHUTTLE: exactly one running corridor. Arrival, stopping, and reverse departure use the same alignment. No second parallel line, loop, passing siding, or turnout.
rail_interface.operating_topology_status: USER_REQUIRED; geometry only; traction, braking, bidirectional running and terminal controls require OEM validation.
rail_interface.rails_per_lane_status: One central nominal guide member; simplified running/suspension interfaces are placeholders, not manufacturer details.
